translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos id Boggoy taddot Ba‑ay'n Bau riyon to Monama
Sokkad no allow to riyon si Disas to templo, nokita rin iddos od pongkoruwonnan no mid ta‑aw to soopi ran diyot tootawwan to soopi.
Woy nokita rin mandad iddos worowora no ba‑ay'n bau no id ta‑aw to oruwon pisus.
Kahin Disas to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no dakkoo pa kos id boggoy ka‑ay't worowora no bau kuntra taddot langun no nokovoggoy.
Su iddos id boggoy to dakkoon soopi, sama robbo idda taddot langun no koruwonnan dan. Piru inin bau, ahad worowora sikandin, id boggoy rin iddos sapuu uvag no soopi rin.”
Dos mgo Kilaannan to Kotompusan to Ingod

Na, duwon mgo tinodduwan din no id po‑ikohiyoy moka‑atag taddot oray'n motoos no templo, su iddot kodbovaa tadda, id gamit iddos mahaa no mgo batu woy duma pon mahaa no id pomboggoy rutun atag to Monama. Piru kahin Disas to,
“Od inguma en kos timpu nod gobban kos langun no nokita row. Oyya su wora ahad sokkad duwot mgo batu no id podluntudluntud nod kosama.”
Na mid intud ki Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din, kahi ran to, “Tohodnonaw, kannu man od kotuman kos id oseng du, woy ondan kos kilaannan no asow ron ini od kotuman?”

Mid tavak si Disas to, “Bantoy kow no konna kow od ko‑okalan. Su mo‑uraa kos od loppow no od po‑uvag‑uvag nod piyod to koddin ngaran nod ikahi no, ‘Siyak en kos Mesiyas,’ woy od ikahi no asow ron kos kotompusan to ingod. Piru yo kow ron en od dumoruma kandan, su uhus kos osengan dan.
Otid pokorinog kow no duwon gira ka‑ay't morani woy riyot moriyu, yo kow'd kovaakki. Oyyos ko‑ilangan en nod kotuman ini langun, piru konna pa ini kos kotompusan to ingod.”
Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Iddos sokkad no ingod, od pokidgira to osson ingod woy dos sokkad no kohoriyan, od pokidgira to osson kohoriyan.

Duwon monokkaan mgo linug woy duwon dakkoon gutas diyot nokod‑osso‑osson lugaa, woy mo‑uraa kos od poomatoy to bohok. Od kokita kow mandad iddos moka‑arat‑arat woy dos mgo mokososoobbu no id pomon diyot datas to langit.

Piru to dii pa ini od kotomanan, od omotton kow nikandan woy'd posupittan. Id boggoy kow riyot bollad to mgo ponguu to simba‑an to Judio woy'd prisuwon. Od piyoddon kow nikandan diyot isowwan to mgo hari woy riyot mgo gubernador pomon to kopomakoy row koddi.
Na, idda ron en kos timpu row no od pokoposivonnaa kow kandan moka‑atag koddi.
De‑en tota‑aw row riyot poomdom dow, no otid inguma ron iddon timpu, yo kow'd kaanu ko ondan kos od osengon dow.
Oyyos od boggayan ku sikiyu to kotuihan to kodtavak woy'd boggayan ku sikiyu to moraom no koovottan, su amoy iddos od pongkuntra koniyu, waa id poko‑apuu ran woy id pokosupak koniyu.
Ahad iddos amoy woy inoy row, mgo suwod, mgo korumannan woy mgo oukuy row, od boggoy koniyu riyot bollad to od pongkuntra koniyu woy dos duma koniyu, od imotayan.
Id kolingasa‑i kow to langun no minuvu pomon to kopomakoy row koddi.
Piru ahad ungketen kos kodposuppit koniyu, waa en od poko‑ahaw koniyu pomon diyot bollad to Monama.
De‑en ponayun kow lohinat no mosalig diyot kopomakoy, su ukit tadda, od kotanggap dow kos umuun waad tomanon.”
Dos Moka‑arat‑arat nod Kotomanan
Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Otid kokita row nod lingkusan don to mgo sundau iddos Jerusalem, od kosorollan dow no asow ron kos kororattan.

Otid inguma ron inin kotomanan, iddos id pon‑oubpa riyot Judea, ko‑ilangan nod paahuy riyot buvunganon. Idda mandad so riyot Jerusalem, ko‑ilangan od paahuy ron woy dos diyot kamot, ko‑ilangan dii ron od livod diyot Jerusalem.
Su ini en kos timpu nod silutan to Monama kos Jerusalem, woy od kotuman iddos langun no no‑ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama.
Iddon timpu, moko‑eru‑eru iddos mgo movoddos woy dos duwon anak nod susu poron! Oyyos lampas en kos koosayan nod inguma taddon bonuwa, su lampas don kos langot to Monama kandan.

Dos duma kandan, od poomatoy to polihuma, dos duma, od omotton woy'd uriponnon diyot osson ingod. Na iddos bonuwa to Jerusalem, od dorattan en, woy idda ron so konna mgo Judio kos od ponguu taman tod kopongnga ron kos timpu to kodponguu ran.”
Dos Kodlivod ni Disas Ka‑ay to Ampow't Ingod

“Na, duwon mandad mokososoobbun mgo kilaannan nod kokita riyot allow, buwan woy riyot mgo bitu‑on. Od ko‑oratan woy'd kotaong kos mgo minuvu ka‑ay to ampow't ingod pomon to dohonoggon to dahat woy doorakkoon baud.
Od kovantang kos mgo minuvu pomon to allak dan tod kotomanan ka‑ay to ampow't ingod. Od pongo‑antog iddos duma pa no riyot datas to langit.
Na, od kokita to langun iddos lampas no se‑aa to kotuusan ku no Anak to Minuvu riyot kod‑inguma ku nod dumannan to souhapun.
De‑en otid tigkanoy ron inin kotomanan, ponokkala row kos ginawa row woy langngag kow riyot datas to langit, su konnod kouhoy, od inguma kos kodtobbus koniyu.”
Dos Ponunggelengan Moka‑atag to Kayu no Igera
Na id itulan dan ni Disas to ponunggelengan, kahi rin to, “Poomdomma row iddos kayun igera woy dos duma pon mgo kayu.
Otid bullas don idda to mgo do‑un, od kokita woy'd kosorollan ta no asow ron kos tintollak.
Iling mandad tadda, otid kokita rowd inin mgo kotomanan, od kosorollan dow no asow ron kos kodharit Monama.
“Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no od kotuman inis langun nod kotomanan, to dii pa od poomatoy kos mgo minuvu no no‑uyag to inin timpu.
Od kowora kos langit woy livuta, piru inis mgo kahi ku, dii en od kowora.”
Dos Kodpanoypanoy to Kodlivod ni Disas

Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “De‑en bantoy kow no dii kow od ko‑uripon to mgo ingowollon ka‑ay to ampow't ingod, iling to lampas no kodka‑an, kodhubughubug woy mgo sowkuu moka‑atag to kod‑oubpa. Su tigkow od inguma iddon allow woy'd kotingkommod kow iling to id sahad diyot lettag.
Oyyos iling taddot kosiyopatoy tod kopaus no lettag, ungketen dad en mandad iddos kod‑inguma taddon allow riyot langun no minuvu ka‑ay to ampow't ingod.
Purisu panoypanoy kow inaayun, woy dasaa kow nod pokoti‑is kow taddot mgo kosupittan nod inguma koniyu woy dasaa kow no waa allak dow to kod‑isau koddi no Anak to Minuvu.”
Na ipat allow, id nonaw si Disas diyot templo woy ipat bulli, id undiyon sikandin to Buvungan to mgo Olibo su riyon sikandin od tinuhon.
De‑en sollom poron, mid undiyon to templo iddos mgo minuvu amoy'd pominog kandin.

footnotes.text: Otik diyot Griego no kinohiyan, waa ahad songo‑silag to bowvuu row nod kowora.
